events.title: When AI Agents Break the Security Model: The Identity Layer As the Fault Line
events.summary: Agentic AI fundamentally challenges the assumptions on which enterprise identity and access management has been built. Traditional IAM relies on deterministic lifecycles, human-speed interaction, and a known population of identities. AI agents violate these assumptions by operating at machine speed, machine scale, and with non-deterministic behavior, exposing limitations in current identity, security, and governance models.
